name: ANTONINO CICCO
bioAdditions: Antonino was born on 15 May 1658, son of Gerolimo Cicco and Berardina Mastroianni (S1). He married Anna Maletta on 5 October 1681 (S2) and was buried on 20 April 1710 (S3).
